description: Upload one existing regular file within an allowed root. Uploads are private by default and never create a public link.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds; omit for the service default.

name.description: Optional stored basename; defaults to the local basename.

path.description: Local path within an allowed root.

visibility.description: account makes the file readable by sibling keys; it is not public.

name: aispace_upload_file
